positions.thesis: S&P 500 index inclusion effective June 22 forces passive-fund buying over the next 11 days. Jensen Huang publicly named MRVL 'next trillion-dollar company'; Q1 FY2026 earnings beat at $2.4B revenue with strong data-center growth. Pre-inclusion price pressure from index-rebalancing flows typically persists until the add date.

WTI crude above $93/barrel driven by 100+ days of US-Iran conflict threatening Strait of Hormuz closure; ExxonMobil's own SVP warned oil could reach $160/barrel on tightening inventories. Exxon's integrated model and production scale make it the cleanest direct equity expression of sustained elevated oil prices, with analyst consensus target of $169.91.
